what.text: This page follows refugees from Somalia living in Yemen, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 40335 Somali refugees in Yemen, 4.5% of all refugees from Somalia.
Kenya and Ethiopia host the most Somali refugees, followed by Uganda and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Somalia in 1984, from 1986 to 1996, in 2001 to 2002 and in every year from 2006 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
From 2006 the government's opponents it records include ARS/UIC, Al-Shabaab and Hizbul Islam.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1989 at 1990 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 255894, at the end of 2017, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2008 to 2020.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Yemen.
These are year-end totals for Yemen only, reported to UNHCR.
